methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNU Collections (collections.unu.edu) is a DSpace repository (URL structure and /server/api & /rest endpoints match DSpace). In principle it supports the same DSpace 7 discovery API as FAO and ESCAP. However, live probing found the entire site — including the API — sitting behind an AWS WAF bot challenge, so automated JSON access is not currently possible.

## Search
The intended path is GET /server/api/discover/search/objects?query={term}&page=0&size=25, returning objects at _embedded.searchResult._embedded.objects[]._embedded.indexableObject. This is captured in config._intendedApi and should be promoted to family 'dspace' the moment the WAF challenge can be satisfied. As a fallback, the HTML site exposes /handle/ record links that a url-catalog crawl can harvest, but even the HTML is challenge-gated for non-browser clients.

## Filters
Standard DSpace facets (dateIssued, type, language, collection) would apply via `&f.<facet>=<value>,equals`, mirroring FAO/ESCAP. Unverified due to the WAF block.

## Download
Standard DSpace ORIGINAL-bundle bitstream resolution (items/{uuid}/bundles -> ORIGINAL -> bitstreams -> /content). Currently unreachable.

## Metadata & Enrichment
DSpace-item enrichment via /server/api/core/items/{uuid} once accessible.

## Limitations
HARD BLOCKER: AWS WAF returns HTTP 202 with response header `x-amzn-waf-action: challenge` and an empty/interstitial body for both the v7 (/server/api) and v6 (/rest) APIs, from multiple browser-like User-Agents. Programmatic access requires solving the JS challenge (headless browser producing a valid AWS WAF token) or IP allow-listing. Until then this source is url-catalog only and effectively non-ingestible via plain HTTP.

Confirms UNU is DSpace but WAF-gated. verified=false: intended DSpace config captured in config._intendedApi for future promotion.
